name: mlb-live-pbp
description: Static MLB scoreboard, game view and replay feed built on the public MLB StatsAPI

scripts.syntax: for f in assets/js/*.js tools/*.mjs tests/*.mjs; do node --check "$f" || exit 1; done && node --check server.mjs
scripts.test: npm run syntax && node tools/page-render-test.mjs && node tools/review-test.mjs && node tools/reviews-feed-test.mjs && node tools/feed-fields-test.mjs && node tools/hit-model-test.mjs && node tools/verify-table-sources.mjs && python3 tools/check-local-links.py && python3 tests/check.py
